body:
Thank you for the suggestion. I took your changes and made some modifications.
Mainly that there
- was an error in the setter always setting the same member on both L and R sides, but R should be in the order of the given vector,
- and that only swizzles without duplications are legal for setters (e.g `vec3.XX = new Vector2(1,2);` is undefined and illegal in HLSL/GLSL)
